recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source fix is needed for FHIR-18829; any future cleanup of stale UML/SVG diagrams should be handled as generated-artifact maintenance rather than as a semantic FHIR-18829 source correction.
issue_request: FHIR-18829 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request raised against STU3 and applied for STU3. It asked to make Appointment and Encounter reason naming/modeling consistent by using reasonCode plus reasonReference targets, renaming Encounter.diagnosis.role to use, and changing Encounter.diagnosis.condition so it no longer described the reason the encounter takes place.
initial_application: The Appointment side appears in adjacent Appointment history: commit 87ce43db92 renamed Appointment.indication usage to reasonReference and updated examples to reasonCode/reasonReference, with reasonReference targeting Condition, Procedure, Observation, and ImmunizationRecommendation. The Encounter side was applied by explicit GF#18829 commit 4d97d1578c, which changed Encounter examples from reason to reasonCode and renamed diagnosis.role to diagnosis.use. Commit 7daa0d220d later merged repeating reasonCode/reasonReference pairs into CodeableReference reason elements while preserving reason-code and reason-reference search surfaces.
additional_context: FHIR-16148 later redesigned Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis for R5. FHIR-19285 moved billing-related diagnosis/procedure rank concerns to Account and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-32130 and FHIR-48869 later added DiagnosticReport support to Encounter and Appointment reason references, and FHIR-48869 explicitly left Encounter.reason.value references as-is; both are already represented on the combined branch. ImmunizationRecommendation was removed from the current core build and from these reason targets by commit e073fb45ec, so its absence is no longer a missing application.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Appointment and Encounter are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Appointment.reason and Encounter.reason.value are current CodeableReference reason elements with current valid targets; Encounter.diagnosis.condition no longer describes the encounter reason; Encounter.diagnosis.use exists; and active search parameters use reason concept/reference paths. A stale generated-looking Appointment SVG still has older target text, but the authoritative StructureDefinition source is correct and diagram-only edits are outside this reconciliation threshold.
